summary.text: Mark Maynard is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who has represented District 6 since January 2015 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He earned a bachelor's degree in business and marketing management from Marshall University and chairs the Senate Transportation and Infrastructure Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mark R. Maynard earned his B.S. in business/marketing management from Marshall University.
He took office in the State Senate on January 11, 2015.

In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the Senate Outdoor Recreation Committee, and in the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee and also serves on the Enrolled Bills, Finance, Government Organization, Health and Human Resources, and Rules committees.
